anchor: bottom centre of each cell (lying: the floor line; falling: the renderer puts the pickup point 6 px above the cell's bottom)

lying.note: it stands on its bell, mouth down, as megaphones do (the row 90 degrees down); the ON AIR lamp blinks

falling.note: it comes down mouth first under its own ceremony ribbon spread like a canopy; the ribbon sways a pixel, the lamp blinks

grip_note: per cell: where the weapon's grip point is in the cell (px, y down), for a hand-over or a catch
star: the megaphone's own roundel (the blue interlaced star on ivory, on the bell's flank) is upright and whole in all four cells
